test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

DHC, GKF, JNI, MQL, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e820d3b929240a6899edfe169fae6274b430efad8398a93b2fd62313f534e356.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• For the **first alphabet**, the pattern is **+3**.
 
• For the **second alphabet**, the pattern is **+3**.
 
• For the **third alphabet**, the pattern is **+3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d588364995867f815c1861464a8db5a59128b09d95e1f384ed9fd3431aeff062.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** “PTO”.**
